handback.summary: Split filing, the pull request off switch and the up-to-date check now read the autopilot label from settings.

criteria.787.1: `default_branch()` in `dokima/agent_autopilot.py` takes `branch.default`; the gate and merge use it, naming it when GitHub lacks it.
criteria.787.2: `default_branch()` asks GitHub's `repos/{repo}` for `default_branch` when empty; `dokima/manifest.py` ties that call to metadata.
criteria.787.3: `merge_method()` gives `--squash`, `--merge` or `--rebase` from `merge.method`, kept on the `--admin` retry.
criteria.787.4: `checks_wait()` turns `gate.checks_wait_min` into seconds; `merge_gate` passes it to `proof`.
criteria.787.5: `autopilot_label()` names the label; the sweep, `on_autopilot`, `dokima/board.py`, split filing and `uptodate.autopilot_of` read by it.
criteria.787.6: `switch_autopilot`, `Board.label` and the pull request off switch in `dokima/agent_roles.py` add and remove the named label.
criteria.787.7: `dokima/defaults.yaml` ships `branch.default` empty, so a repo with no settings asks GitHub.
criteria.787.8: `env_lines` in `dokima/settings.py` fills an empty branch from the event file or `gh`, else fails saying so.
criteria.787.9: Already built by #784: `filed_label()` reads `labels.filed`; its test passed before any change.

raises.label: Workflow trigger fixed name
raises.text: The autopilot workflow still triggers on the fixed label name, so a renamed label never starts it.
